label: Experientialism: desirability in each respect is fixed by the bearer's experiential profile
paraphrase: Recorded rival, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for lives of experiencing subjects, a bearer's desirability (q.5 DesirableIn) in each respect is fixed by its experiential profile, so two bearers with the same profile are desirable in exactly the same respects (the map x to DesirableIn x factors through the profile). Equivalently, some valuation of profiles fixes desirability in every respect. It says nothing about how desirable any profile is; hedonism proper is one valuation. The generic Lean definition does not restrict the bearers to experiencing subjects.
